messages:
mike: Heads up — CloudWave partner asking for a 30% reseller margin on a one-year commit (~$520k). They want to offer a deep discount to their customers and want us to sign off + cover a short POC on dedicated infra. Our public partner rate card is 20% standard. Need deal-desk + sec + finance guidance.
anya: Do we have a strategic partner tier that could justify >20%? what's the expected ARR and logo value?
javier: CloudWave has a few enterprise logos we wanted to win; pipeline looks promising but not guaranteed. 520k TCV is plausible.
sophie: For the POC: they'll need isolated infra and a temporary private deployment. Estimate for 2-week sandbox on Dedicated: ~$4k infra + SRE time. Also security questionnaire inbound — SOC2 + KMS questions.
olivia: Please open a deal-desk request and attach pricing justification, list of concessions (free POC, co-marketing, extended SLA), and the revenue recognition schedule. For anything >25% we need VP sign-off. Submit with SR/DD number.
mike: Uploaded a draft term sheet here: https://drive.redwood/CloudWave-deal (DM me if access issues)
olivia: Noted. A few quick rules from deal desk: 1) reseller net effective discount cap 25% unless escalated, 2) any POC costs should be recorded as one-time concessions, 3) include margin recapture clause if they resell below agreed pricing.
financebot: Deal desk request received: DD-2026-188. Routing to finance for margin impact analysis.
vp-sales: I can approve up to 27.5% in exceptional cases if partner commits to $600k ARR and 12mo auto-renew. Otherwise target 25%.
javier: CloudWave can't stretch to 600k right now. Suggest 25% for 500k + paid 2-week POC and a 6mo performance review.
mike: I'll push that: 25% + POC fee + co-marketing + quarterly reporting. Will ask CloudWave to sign addendum preventing downstream sublicensing and require monthly sales reporting.
olivia: If we go >25% we need a legal addendum (no sublicensing, lead registration, audit rights) and finance needs a waterfall showing gross->net margin. Also include an exit clause if they don't hit commit.
sophie: Tagging sec: @kevin-sec — can we provide SOC2 attestation and KMS options for a short POC? Need written answers for their security questionnaire by EOD tomorrow.
kevin-sec: We can provide SOC2 Type II attestation and confirm TLS1.2+/AES-256 in transit and at rest. For private deployments we support customer KMS integrations (AWS KMS / GCP KMS). I'll upload certs and an answers doc to the secure folder.
olivia: Once sec doc uploaded and deal-desk form is complete, I'll route to legal. Expect 24–48h turnaround assuming finance sign-off.
mike: Sounds good — I'll update CloudWave with the counter: 25% reseller margin conditional on $500k commit, paid POC, and addendum. Will ping back with their response. :thumbsup:
javier: Thanks — please @olivia when they accept. Might be a quick win if they agree to the co-marketing commitments.
kevin-sec: Uploaded security pack to secure drive: https://secure.redwood/CloudWave-sec. Leaving notes in the doc about minimum config for the POC.
financebot: Margin analysis completed: effective margin at 25% with concessions = 18% net. Recommend approval subject to reporting and recapture clause.
olivia: Routing to legal now (LG-2026-77). I'll update this thread when legal signs off.
mike: Great, thanks everyone. Updating CloudWave now.
